quality_review.method: Visual inspection of all six source images and paired output text; class keywords/format are only screening proxies, not factual ground truth.

rejected_settings.reason: Chair invents bathroom context; Table renders cloth as an unsupported object/word.
Chair and Sofa invent bathroom context.
Sofa introduces a separate pillow claim unsupported by the visible image.
Additional desk image retries and becomes slower; do not apply indiscriminately.

quality_review.selected_policy: 420px only for all high-confidence (>=0.8) Chair/Sofa/couch detections; otherwise448px. 60tokens retained.
quality_limits: Baseline additional desk contains the unclear word 쇼트; conservative policy preserves rather than fixes this pre-existing error.
Obstacle statements are model quotes, not physical safety labels.
Only six valid images and few repetitions; no test data used and no general quality guarantee.
quality_review.token_finding: 40 token cap does not help normal short EOS outputs, and still requires a second generation for the desk; retain60 for headroom.
